title: pi-statusline manifest
description: Maps pi extension status keys (ctx.ui.setStatus) to styled footer segments. Optional; consumed by the pi-statusline footer extension.

statusKey.description: The key an extension publishes with ctx.ui.setStatus(key, text).

label.description: Short prefix shown before the value (defaults to statusKey).

color.description: Theme color token for the label.

position.description: Placement hint for footers that order by position.
